Welcome to your perfectly located OASIS at "THE DESERT DIAMOND!"
✴ ✴ ✴ ✴ ✴ JUST MINUTES FROM OLD TOWN SCOTTSDALE ✴ ✴ ✴ ✴ ✴ 

✴ ✴ ✴ 6 ROOMS (INCLUDES GAME ROOM), 3 FULL BATHROOMS, 14 BEDS, COURTYARD, BACKYARD, PATIO, HOT TUB, POOL, PICKLE BALL, BASKETBALL, 2 FIRE PITS, OPEN FLOOR PLAN HOME FOR ENTERTAINING, 9 TVS, FULLY STOCKED! THIS HOME HAS IT ALL & JUST MINUTES TO OLD TOWN! OLD TOWN'S BEST! THERE IS NO PROPERTY LIKE THE DESERT DIAMOND! ✴ ✴✴ 

Purposefully & functionally designed for Airbnb guests looking for their very own LUXE Old Town Scottsdale vacation home. Every detail was meticulously thought out by vacation rental designers & Airbnb Superhosts Reed and Crystal. Spend some time outside in the HUGE backyard swimming, playing pickleball/basketball, barbecuing, or playing mini golf & yard games. Have some quality family/yourself time! Lots of great hiking/biking trails nearby.

This home is very close to Old Town Scottsdale. You'll be minutes away from the best restaurants, nightlife, world-class golf courses, hiking trails, and highly regarded shopping malls such as Fashion Square Mall. Lots of restaurants, coffee, & grocery within WALKING DISTANCE.

"THE DESERT DIAMOND" is a LUXE Old Town Scottsdale destination home which includes a private sparkling heated pool, REGULATION size pickleball sport court, and every other amenity that you could want! Feel like you have an entire resort just to yourself! No expense was sparred when creating this newly renovated mid century property with every designer touch that you can expect in your perfect Scottsdale destination space. Note: Pool heating is REQUIRED October through April & billed after booking at a rate of $50/daily. This helps offset the large natural gas bill.

"THE DESERT DIAMOND" comfortably sleeps 14 guests with 14 beds! Each person has their own bed! STRICT ENFORCEMENT ON GUEST COUNT PLEASE. THIS IS NOT A PARTY HOUSE. Although it is setup with your vacation & entertainment in mind we do ask that you enjoy this LUXE property responsibly & respectfully. Please keep in mind the Scottsdale noise ordinance, neighbors, & quiet hours.

- Equipped with everything you need for a short or long stay.
- There isn't anything this house does not have. You will never have to leave!
- We deep clean and update the furniture regularly. We use new linens, pillows, comforters, duvet covers as often as needed to keep everything clean and fresh. We clean the upholstery monthly to keep our property in tip top shape. We have no carpet in the home so the home stays sparkling clean.

- NO LIFEGUARD ON DUTY. SUPERVISE CHILDREN AT ALL TIMES.

HEATED POOL - BY BOOKING GUESTS AGREE TO POOL WAIVER AND RULES
**Pool heating is REQUIRED October through April. $50/daily**

This is not a profit center. The small daily fee helps cover the energy costs & pool heater maintenance. We do not turn the heater on and off. It is more efficient to heat the entire pool and keep it heated. This keeps the cost down in comparison to other Airbnb pools (similar pools are $50-$95 to heat daily).

*Pool heater is set comfortably at 84-88 degrees (depending on the month).
*Pool heating will be billed after booking & for the ENTIRE STAY.
*Pool does not need to be heated mid to late May through mid September.
*Pool is serviced twice weekly. Usually Sundays/Mondays & Thursdays/Fridays.
(Times subject to change)

Have fun traveling to Sunny Scottsdale!

 Guest access 
Guests will have exclusive access to this private resort home.

 Other things to note 
Parking: 2 cars can park in the driveway and 2-3 on the street. Please only park up to 5 cars at the house. If you have extra cars there is a grocery store parking lot a quick 2 minute walk around the corner. That way the street stays clear of cars. Thank you.
